How to find the right part for a Ford Cargo

EKS LKW · 06.11.2026

Two Ford Cargo trucks from the same year can have a different engine, gearbox or axle. That is why our first question on the phone is not “which model?” but “what does it say on the part?”.

1. Start with the old part

The number on the removed part is the most reliable information. On Ford parts it usually looks like 7C46 7550 BA (a clutch disc) or CC46 2L324 AA (a parking brake valve). Copy it in full, including the letters at the end, and take a clear photo of the label or stamped marking.

If the part carries several numbers, send all of them. One may be the Ford number, another the manufacturer's number, another a batch number. We sort them out when we check.

2. Say where it is fitted

For brakes, suspension and steering, the axle and side matter: front or rear, left or right. For an electrical part, photograph the connector too; the number of pins is easier to see in a photo than in a description. For hoses and pipes, a photo showing both ends helps.

3. The VIN helps when the number is missing

The chassis number (VIN) is in the registration document and on the plate in the cab. With it we can check the factory configuration when the part has no label left or has already been replaced by a part from another source. The VIN field in our form is optional. If you send a photo of the registration document, cover the owner's details; we only need the chassis number.

4. The body has its own plate

A tipper body, crane, tank or refuse compactor is not made by Ford. For those parts we need the equipment manufacturer and the serial number from the equipment plate, not the truck's VIN.

5. Ask for confirmation before ordering

The quote states the exact part number, the manufacturer (genuine Ford or aftermarket), the lead time and the price. If the suffix differs or there is a superseding version, we tell you before you order.

No part number? Tell us which part you need, for which truck, and what it looks like. We start from there and ask for anything that is missing.
